subject: Press room interview slots + onsite logo usage — addendum request
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@eventco.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00Z
Subject: Press room interview slots + onsite logo usage — addendum request

Hi Liam,

Thanks again for the package outline — excited to be part of EVTC 2026. A few quick asks from our side that we'd like to add as a short addendum to the SOW so our comms and product marketing teams can plan: 

- One dedicated press interview slot (15 minutes) for Redwood VP of Product on the morning media block (ideally between 10:00–11:30 local).
- A branded press table near the press room entry for two reps during the media window (table + one floor sign).
- Explicit logo usage rights for the event press release, the online press kit, and one post-event press email (we will not use beyond the press assets).
- AV support: a lav + walk mic and direct stream feed to press room monitors for the interview.

I'm attaching our logo spec sheet so we can ensure the artwork they use is current. Can you confirm whether the interview time is something you can reserve, and whether EventCo will require any special press credentialing or embargo terms? If you can send a quick addendum we can route to legal and sign via DocuSign.

If the interview slot requires a sponsorship tier bump or nominal fee, call it out and we'll evaluate.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Events & Partnerships, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Sponsor_Logo_Specs.pdf (image/png, 280KB)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@eventco.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: EventCo Press Team <press@eventco.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T13:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Press room interview slots + onsite logo usage — addendum request

Hi Jordan — thanks for the clear ask. Good to have you on board. Quick answers: 

- We have a dedicated media block on Nov 30 from 10:00–12:00. We can reserve a 10–15 minute interview slot for Redwood; the 15-minute slot is doable but will require confirmation by end of week.
- Press table space is available; we typically provide a 6-foot table + two chairs in the press antechamber.
- Logo usage: partners in the Sponsor tier can be included in the event press release and online press kit. For partner logos to appear in EventCo's press email we require a signed addendum that includes a usage credit line ("EventCo partner: Redwood Inference"). No problem with the single post-event inclusion you described.
- AV: lav + feed to press monitors is available but requires prebooking through our AV house (we'll share the AV rider).

I'll attach a high-level press-room plan and the proposed addendum. There is a $3,500 addendum fee if you need the 15-minute reserved interview plus the press table in the prime spot next to the press room entrance. If you don't want the fee, we can offer a 10-minute interview for no extra charge.

Link: https://www.eventco.com/press-portal/EVTC-2026

Best,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Sponsorships, EventCo Media
liam@eventco.com | +1 212-555-0142

Attachment: press-room-plan.pdf (application/pdf, 450KB)

Jordan / Kim — quick internal note on strategy:

- We should take the 15-minute slot. Having the VP in a 15-minute press sit-down is higher value for post-event PR than a 10-min soundbite.
- Offer to run a 45-minute pre-show workshop/demo on Nov 29 as the tradeoff for the $3,500 addendum. That workshop will be promoted in the partner track and will give us lead capture.
- Add a clause in the addendum: "Partner logos used in press materials will not be altered in a way that reduces brand prominence without prior written consent by Redwood Inference."

I'll attach a one-page MAP template so we can spell out deliverables (speaker name, bio, AV needs). If we move fast we can sign and have assets to EventCo by EOD Friday.

Camila

Jordan / Camila — following up with what's possible after checking with programming and AV. Good news: we can accommodate the 15-minute interview slot on Nov 30 at 10:15 if Redwood signs the attached addendum and commits to the pre-show workshop on Nov 29.

Conditions: 
- Addendum fee: $3,500 (covers reserved interview + prime press table placement).
- Workshop commitment: 45-minute pre-show partner workshop listed in partner track.
- Logo usage: allowed in the event press release, online press kit, and one post-event press email provided you include the credit line exactly as: "EventCo partner: Redwood Inference." EventCo reserves the right to crop or scale logos to match layout, but we will not alter logo colors. We will include a clause referencing the prior written consent you requested — "no alteration to logo prominence without written consent."

If that all reads OK I'll send the DocuSign link for signature and our AV rider.

Best,
Liam

Attachment: EVTC_Addendum_0473.pdf (application/pdf, 48KB)
